description: Permissions of the FineRetouch editor window. The engine sidecar is started by the Rust core (src/engine.rs); the webview may only run it with --version, to show the engine build in About. Exports use the dialog plugin (native Save As and folder pickers) and the fs plugin. The fs plugin may write only inside the app's exports folder ($DATA/FineRetouch/exports, i.e. %APPDATA%\FineRetouch\exports on Windows) and to files and folders the user picked in a dialog: picks are added to the fs scope at runtime and kept across launches by tauri-plugin-persisted-scope. Nothing here allows reading, listing or deleting user files.
